data.title: Cardiff Lexington Creates New A-1 Preferred Control Shares
data.description:
Cardiff Lexington ( (CDIX) ) has issued an update.

On August 31, 2026, Cardiff Lexington Corporation filed a certificate of designation in Nevada creating a new series A-1 preferred stock, limited to two shares and structured to rank senior to common stock, on parity with series A preferred, and junior to several existing senior preferred series. The A-1 shares carry a $250 stated value in liquidation, have no dividend or economic participation rights, and are entitled to a voting power equal to 25% of all other equity votes plus one, though they convert automatically into common stock upon most transfers, effectively concentrating control while minimally affecting the company’s economic capitalization.

This move formalizes an instrument designed primarily for voting control rather than financial return, potentially influencing corporate governance dynamics and decision-making without materially diluting common shareholders’ economic interests. By separating economic rights from voting power and tightly limiting transferability, Cardiff Lexington reinforces a capital structure that can stabilize control among designated holders while preserving existing priority arrangements among senior and parity securities in the event of corporate transactions or liquidation.

data.title: Stewards Inc Amends Loan Agreement and Warrant Terms
data.description:
Stewards Inc ( (SWRD) ) has issued an announcement.

On September 3, 2026, Stewards, Inc. amended its September 17, 2025 loan agreement with Stewards International Funds PCC, extending the facility closing date from August 31, 2026 to November 15, 2026 while maintaining the $100 million limit, 8.00% annual interest rate and August 31, 2030 maturity, and confirming that notes issued remain unsecured and unsubordinated. The amendment reduces warrant coverage on principal funded after August 31, 2026 to one facility warrant per $3.00, requires all earned warrants to be issued by November 15, 2026, and keeps the warrant exercise price at $0.76 per share, with related-party chairman Glen Steward recusing himself and disinterested directors approving the deal as fair to the company and its shareholders.

The facility warrants issued for principal advanced under the loan will be exercisable for restricted shares of common stock at $0.76 per share after the later of the August 31, 2030 maturity date or a liquidity event and for three years thereafter, and will rely on private offering exemptions, limiting immediate resale and adding a structured equity-like component to the company’s funding mix. While the amendment itself does not advance new principal or automatically issue warrants, it lengthens the window in which additional obligations and corresponding warrant grants may arise, potentially affecting capital structure and dilution depending on how much funding the company draws during the extended period.

data.title: Lake Winn Resources Cuts Debt Through Share Issuance to Creditors
data.description:
Lake Winn Resources ( (TSE:LWR) ) has shared an announcement.

Lake Winn Resources Corp. has completed a shares-for-debt settlement, converting $454,573.05 of outstanding obligations to certain creditors into 6,993,430 common shares at a deemed price of $0.065 per share. The move effectively reduces the company’s debt load while expanding its equity base, reflecting a strategic effort to strengthen its balance sheet and improve financial flexibility.

Insiders participated in the transaction, making it a related party deal under Canadian securities rules, but the company relied on available exemptions since the value of insider-issued shares is less than 25% of its market capitalization. All new shares are subject to a four-month-plus-one-day hold period, and the settlement remains contingent on final approval from the TSX Venture Exchange, underscoring ongoing regulatory oversight and implications for existing shareholders’ dilution and corporate governance.
